performance.data: pre-generated CPU synthetic tensors; in-memory DataLoader num_workers=0; no disk/decode benchmark
statistics: actual samples / matching total wall seconds
performance.memory: raw ru_maxrss, OS-specific unit, lifetime high-water scope including import/data/warmup; not live tensor bytes; separate theoretical X/y bytes
performance.acceptance: finite positive durations, actual 30 updates and sample counts, finite loss/parameters and changed parameters; no required acceleration or accuracy threshold

gradient.model: small deterministic linear layer, no BN/dropout
gradient.partitions: at least one equal and one unequal nonempty partition; six-sample 3+3 / 2+4 in lab are suggestions, main 3+3 / 4+3 valid
routes: aggregate local sum gradients then divide by actual total samples
gradient.update: one SGD step, same initial independent snapshot, no momentum or weight decay
gradient.negativeControl: unequal partitions naive unweighted local-mean average differs; compare each weight and bias

parameterServer.mode: CPU logical sequential roles, no network
required: receive each worker exactly once for current step/key
normalize once then exactly one SGD update
all workers receive same updated parameter version
changed arrival order agrees within floating tolerance
missing, duplicate and stale-step contributions cannot count as full successful synchronous update

communication.nature: analytic budget only; no byte payload transmitted
communication.assumptions: root/PS ingress then egress serial; ring links concurrent; no protocol/startup/compute/contention cost

parentEvidenceReported: Main reported successful finite CPU performance and gradient checks in sources/p5-shared; worker did not rerun or independently read those results; logical PS and communication acceptance owned by Main.
